                         INDEPENDENT AUDITOR'S CONSENT


We consent to the use in the Registration Statement and Prospectus of
PracticeWorks, Inc. of our report dated September 30, 1999, accompanying the
consolidated financial statements of Medical Dynamics, Inc. contained in such
Registration Statement, and to the use of our name and the statements with
respect to us, as appearing under the headings "Independent Certified Public
Accountants" in the Prospectus.


/s/ Hein & Associates LLP
HEIN + ASSOCIATES LLP



Denver, Colorado
August 15, 2000
